name: Power BI
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst

days.lab_task: Load a supplied ten-row sales table into Power BI, create revenue and order-count measures, then build a page with a monthly trend and regional breakdown. Reconcile visuals to a supporting table.
days.deliverable: Power BI report, measure definitions and reconciliation note
days.assessment:
The revenue card equals the sum of the ten supplied sales rows
A region filter changes both the trend and supporting table consistently
Order count remains distinct from revenue and both visuals have labeled units
learning_objectives: Create explicit measures rather than relying on implicit aggregation
Explain how report filters affect a visual
days.scenario: A sales manager needs a report whose totals can be traced to the source rows.
preparation_requirements: Prepare the stated lab fixture or training environment

Verify expected results: The revenue card equals the sum of the ten supplied sales rows; A region filter changes both the trend and supporting table consistently; Order count remains distinct from revenue and both visuals have labeled units

delivery_steps.activity: A sales manager needs a report whose totals can be traced to the source rows.
delivery_steps.evidence: Baseline example and first expected result

days.lab_task: Extend the supplied report with a date table and monthly visual. Preserve the missing month as missing data, add a report-level date filter and document the selected missing-data treatment.
days.deliverable: Updated report page and missing-data decision note

The missing month is not silently displayed as zero revenue
Changing the date filter updates all specified visuals consistently
The note explains the data-quality limitation and identifies the source owner to contact

Validate filter context using a supporting table
